meta.scenario: T1 has active vocal in exit zone, T2 has vocal in intro — short overlap + mid EQ cut to prevent vocal clash

transition_arc: T1 exit zone has vox=0.6–0.8 (lead vocal active). T2 intro zone also has vox=0.4 starting at bar 8. Vocal-on-vocal collision is guaranteed if overlap exceeds 8 bars. Solution: cut T1 mids to 0.25 the moment T2 fade starts, keep overlap to 8 bars (one phrase), then hard cut T1. Bass kill + mid cut on T1 creates space for T2 vocal to enter cleanly. The low-overlap forces a committed transition — no lingering.

annotated_actions.t1_state: T1 bar 0: full groove, vocal enters at bar 16, RMS 0.60
T1 bar 64: vox=0.7, harmonic=0.6 — vocal is fully active
annotated_actions.why: T1 has an active vocal (vox=0.7) and T2 will also have a vocal at bar 8. Cutting T1 mids to 0.25 aggressively suppresses T1 vocal so T2 vocal can enter without clashing. This fires at the same bar as the fade_in start. No restore — T1 is fading out.
Kill T2 bass at blend start to prevent dual bassline.

annotated_actions.t2_state: T2 bar 0: percussion intro, vox=0.0 (vocal not yet active), drums=0.5
annotated_actions.why: Only 8-bar overlap because T2 vocal enters at bar 8. Keeping it short avoids T1 vocal (even suppressed) fighting T2 vocal. T2 starts from its percussion intro which is clean.

annotated_actions.t1_state: T1 bar 64: still has bass but mid is already cut
annotated_actions.why: Swap bass immediately at blend start — 8-bar overlap is too short to delay the swap. T1 mid is already at 0.25 so the swap completes the EQ handoff.
Restore T2 bass immediately at bass_swap point.

annotated_actions.t1_state: T1 bar 64: vocal active but mids cut to 0.25 — effectively suppressed
annotated_actions.why: Fast 8-bar fade. T1 vocal is inaudible at mid=0.25. Fade completes before T2 vocal enters at bar 8.

annotated_actions.t2_state: T2 bar 8: vocal entering, full groove building, RMS 0.55
annotated_actions.why: T2 takes over at the exact bar its vocal enters. T1 is silent. Clean handoff.
